families.details: Main/Japanese text, monospace logic, icon and tech fonts retain readable glyphs and original metrics.

Sun, Serpulo, Erekir, Tantros and asteroid meshes are generated from geometry/noise, not omitted image files. Their original functional surface palettes and geometry remain. Campaign emblems and space cubemap are provided by the art domains.
41 shader files retained. New source textures remain separate, preserving sampler names and runtime tint behavior.
Primitive circles, rays, dust, smoke, lightning and explosions retain official drawing algorithms and gameplay parameters. All texture dependencies have explicit source mappings.
16 bubble and 12 splash masks exported; 50 liquid and 50 gas regions generated by preserved official algorithm.
Rotation, recoil, legs, tread frames, draw-part loops and moving pistons consume the new original-canvas layers. Their renderer is not a separate missing art sheet.
114 msav files are binary gameplay maps, not images. Source content layouts, procedural world generators and map saves are preserved in the upstream game; no map save is represented as new art.

scopeLimitation: These dependencies are explicitly reused. This package does not claim that every font outline, procedural particle or 3D mesh has been redrawn in the Daoist style.
